name: xkcd
commands:
c=~/.cache/xkcd
mkdir -p "$c"
info=$(curl -fsm 10 https://xkcd.com/info.0.json) || exit
num=$(jq -r .num <<< "$info")
[ -s "$c/$num.png" ] || curl -fsm 20 -o "$c/$num.png" "$(jq -r .img <<< "$info")"
find "$c" -name '*.png' ! -name "$num.png" -delete
jq -c --arg path "$c/$num.png" '{num, title: .safe_title, alt, path: $path}' <<< "$info"
